notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
All functions are accessible with a controller
 In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
 Performs well with medium settings
 FSR can be enabled as well to boost performance
 Some interactions may be easier using the touchpad
 The game will be run through Proton

notes.title: V.1.2.7
notes.content:
New Gameplay Video added to the store page
 New gameplay features:
 Teleview: You can use this power to connect with the White Crow and see the ending location through his eyes.
 Teleport: This power can be used instead of televiewing, when the 3 gems are collected and the Ritual is performed.


 New option to adjust or turn off the Music Volume
 First two endings now act as a tutorial
 No Abduction until getting the first two endings
 Abduction time will decrease gradually with progress
 Magic Boxes are now more powerfull against possession
 New platforming challenge with reward at the Tree of Life
 Music boxes fade out the background music
 More consumables added
 More foliage and props
 Balanced sound levels
 Some visual glitches fixed
 Some minor bug fixes

notes.title: V.1.2.6
notes.content:
A new "Gameplay Video" is coming soon to the store page!


 New hints reveal according to the progress and inventory, providing more specific guidance like an ingame tutorial
 New street signs for easier navigation in the city, complementing the new hint system
 Upgraded main boss Lylah
 Additional changes will reveal as you progress further into the story
 Visual improvements: updated sky, more foliage and props
 More balanced sound levels
 Some minor bug fixes

P.S. The new Gameplay Video aims to assist casual players by showcasing the game's basics. However, the newly implemented hint system will guide all players in the game, especially during the learning phase.
